0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz, 1-7 and 14th in the West after six straight losses and a 0-3 road record, visit the 4-4 Dallas Mavericks, who are 11th in the West and on a two-game losing streak, in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Kyrie Irving (illness) and Max Christie (hip) are listed as day-to-day. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, and their last meeting was a 138-120 Jazz loss in Dallas on January 17, 2026.
